architecture.summary: This candidate changes PR reporting policy and its documentation only. It places the main review summary and any architecture comparison in the PR description, with Validation and Quality review as maintained evidence comments. Runtime code, public contracts, source ownership, dependencies, authority, resource lifetimes, trust boundaries, containers, and deployment topology do not change. Checked context, hosted/local containers and owner mapping, component scopes, runtime collaboration overview, and deployment views remain accurate. No registry edit or production callable-contract comparison is needed.
